subject: Re: demogen status - shipping it as a filter, and closing the budget loop
body:
Decision for the Jun 30 write-up: we ship it as a coarse filter, not a ranker. Drop the bottom quartile of candidate configs before training. On last quarter's actual sweep volume that would have saved about 9,000 GPU-hours with one config wrongly dropped out of 84. I can defend that trade; I could not defend claiming a ranking at 0.61.

Umar - please state the DEMOGEN 0.87 and our 0.61 side by side, with the data-mixture explanation. The gap between them is the most useful paragraph in the doc.

Idris, closing a loop: the $120k on Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-81 is ours for Q3, as you confirmed verbally back in April. We've spent about $74k of it on the zoo, 176 configs trained in the end. I'd like the remaining ~$46k held on the same line for the filter's integration work rather than returned. Can you confirm in writing this week - Q3 OKRs locked Friday and I don't want this floating.

Dmitri
